classification.class: provider provisioning failure before a pod existed
classification.basis: The provider returned HTTP 500 while creating compute. No pod, SSH endpoint, filesystem, model process, score payload, or arm data existed.

repair.action: Permit the single frozen redeployment attempt against the same still-available hardware resource.
repair.failure_disposition: If the redeployment fails, stop Stage C6 v1 and report a terminal infrastructure failure. Do not try another resource.

immutable_fields: All initialization bytes, constrained semantics, tasks, arms, seeds, order, policy-call budgets, optimizer settings, support thresholds, scientific metrics, decision rules, artifact policy, and cost ceiling remain unchanged.
